name: Paneer Tikka Bowl
steps: Cut paneer into 2.5 cm cubes. Mix 120 g curd, 15 ml oil, ginger, garlic, chilli powder, cumin, coriander powder, garam masala, turmeric, 2 g salt and 15 ml lemon juice. Coat paneer gently and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

Meanwhile rinse rice, drain well and put in a saucepan with the measured water and 3 g salt. Bring to a boil, cover and cook on low heat for 12 minutes. Switch off and rest covered for 10 minutes, then fluff.

Blend mint, fresh coriander, green chilli, remaining 40 g curd, 1 g salt and 10 ml lemon juice into a thick chutney. Slice onion and dice cucumber and tomato; toss the vegetables with the remaining 10 ml lemon juice.

Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and brush with the remaining 15 ml oil. Lift paneer from excess marinade and cook in batches for 8 minutes, turning carefully until browned at the edges and hot throughout. Avoid crowding the pan.
Divide rice among 4 bowls. Arrange paneer tikka, onion, cucumber and tomato in distinct sections and spoon mint chutney over one side. Serve while the rice and paneer are warm.
tips: Use thick curd so the coating adheres. Prepare the rice, chutney and salad during marination; prolonged grilling makes paneer tough.
passiveTime: Allow 30 minutes for marinating; prepare the other components during this time.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
